interface.longDescription:
See where AI answer engines mention or recommend your brand, compare competitors, and explore visibility across the buyer journey.

Inspect recorded answers and citations, investigate visibility gaps, and develop practical next steps grounded in evidence. Create a one-page brief or comprehensive report from your tracked results.

Work directly from your assistant to add or delete tracked prompts and manage competitors, with the appropriate permissions.
defaultPrompt: Suggest new prompts to track for my brand.
How visible is my brand in AI answers?
Where are competitors ahead of my brand?
